reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that docks the todo panel in the upper-right corner, supports configurable hot-reloaded styling, and preserves todo visibility across turns and restarts.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 todo 面板停靠到网页右上角，并通过可热更新的样式和会话事件重放保持任务列表跨轮次可见。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that docks the todo panel in the upper-right corner and keeps task lists visible across turns through hot-reloaded styling and session event replay.

capabilities: Injects CSS into the web interface to reposition and style the todo panel
Listens to session events and replays the latest todo list across conversation turns
Reads persisted session events to restore the latest todo list after restart
